CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM sampled_at))::bigint AS epoch_second, floor((extract(epoch FROM sampled_at) - floor(extract(epoch FROM sampled_at))) * 1000000000)::integer AS nano FROM (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS sampled_at) sampled ) storage_clock WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.source_kind = 'execution' AND ((p.status = 'PENDING' AND (p.available_epoch_second, p.available_nano) <= (storage_clock.epoch_second, storage_clock.nano)) OR (p.status = 'CLAIMED' AND (p.lease_until_epoch_second, p.lease_until_nano) <= (storage_clock.epoch_second, storage_clock.nano))) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_state_publications head WHERE head.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND head.source_id = p.source_id AND head.source_revision < p.source_revision AND head.status <> 'ACKNOWLEDGED') ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.status = 'CLAIMED' THEN p.lease_until_epoch_second ELSE p.available_epoch_second END, CASE WHEN p.status = 'CLAIMED' THEN p.lease_until_nano ELSE p.available_nano END, p.source_id, p.source_revision, p.event_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF p SKIP LOCKED
